luiskr.com / core/utils/media / webmSibling

function webmSibling(url): string

Defined in: core/utils/media.ts:143

Derives the .webm sibling of an .mp4 URL — same convention as webpSibling: x.mp4 → x.webm and x.mp4-scaledown-2x.mp4 → x.mp4-scaledown-2x.webm. Returns '' for non-.mp4 input.

Parameters

url

string

MP4 media URL.

Returns

string

The same URL with .webm instead of .mp4, or '' when not .mp4.
